meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Codex 设为主智能体,接替 Claude 做规划、调用工具并恢复历史会话。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望终端 AI 的规划与工具调度由 Codex 接管。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex to lead planning and tool calls in your terminal instead of Claude.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 的分组可以改用 Codex(OpenAI codex app-server)作为完整 agent 后端,由它做规划、工具编排、MCP 工具和服务端会话历史;凭据只走 OneCLI vault。
howto.when: 当你要求把某个分组切换到 Codex 后端,或让新建分组默认使用 Codex 时,它会接管该分组的运行。

say.text: 把当前分组切到 codex provider
say.note: 执行 groups config update 并重启该分组

say.text: 帮我给 codex 做一次登录认证
把新分组的默认 provider 改成 codex

howto.what_en: After install, each NanoClaw group can use Codex (OpenAI codex app-server) as its full agent backend — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — credentials stay in the OneCLI vault only.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you switch a group to the Codex backend, or make new groups default to Codex.

say_en.text: Switch this group to the codex provider
say_en.note: Runs groups config update --provider codex and restarts the group

say_en.text: Run the Codex login for me
say_en.note: Runs provider-auth codex and stores credentials in the OneCLI vault
Sets DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER and restarts the host
